findings: Unattributed7x/20x/70percent comparisons, fixed10M/100M cardinality caps, unlimited retention/scaling and100M/day selection threshold were replaced with workload-dependent criteria; historical measured results were not relabelled as current benchmarks.
Replaced obsolete1.96 image guidance with verified1.151.0 tags. Stack0.92.1 contains operator chart0.67.3/operator0.74.1; chart kubeVersion guard is not an EKS compatibility guarantee.
Removed full PromQL/every-API equivalence claims. Documented rate/increase, NaN, scalar, name and implicit-window differences.
A Deployment Pod name cannot provide a stable vmagent shard ordinal. StatefulSet names ending in a valid ordinal are supported; the minimal Deployment now uses one replica without sharding flags.
Replaced IPv4-only address rewrites and insecure kubelet scraping with namespace-scoped Pod discovery, named TCP metrics port, optional scrape path, and minimal Pod-read RBAC.
emptyDir queue persistence stops at Pod replacement; queue disk caps drop oldest data. Storage buffering is not backup or lossless delivery.

Aligned vmselect/vmstorage dedup and replication settings, documented replication history assumptions, partial responses, failure domains and2*N-1 sizing conditions; RF2 is not an unconditional no-loss guarantee.
Native1.151 rejects anomaly_score; replaced with gauge zscore_over_time and corrected lag/lifetime/scrape_interval/range-function scope and label manipulation caveats.

The old status-labelled error ratio returned1 for10percent failures. New service aggregation returns0/1/0.1 for healthy/all-failed/mixed and excludes zero or absent traffic; arbitrary default0 is not a remedy.

Histogram share now uses windowed bucket rates; p50/p90/p99 recorded separately because same-label or loses later quantiles. CPU derivation uses counter rate, not an average of cumulative CPU seconds.
Recording derived series does not compact/delete raw history. Alternative recording groups must not emit duplicate record names concurrently.

Corrected operator-stack values from victoria-metrics-single/cluster to vmsingle/vmcluster and verified output CRs. Starter profile opts into owned scrapes and documents disabled monitoring components/production prerequisites.
Removed duplicate args mappings and nonexistent storage.maxDiskSpace. Retention and free-disk write-stop thresholds are different; memory.allowedPercent controls caches, not total RSS.

Raw StatefulSet PVC is storage-vmsingle-0. Replaced invalid arbitrary CronJob/static AWS-key setup with matching-storage backup workflow, RWO/co-location constraints, workload identity and distinct member prefixes. Azure support was verified and retained.

Corrected vmctl flags to --prom-snapshot and --vm-addr; cluster mode requires --vm-account-id. Removing an old remote-write path requires a verified replacement collector, not merely a Grafana datasource change.
Removed mutating blanket delete/snapshot/force-merge operations from read-only diagnostics. TSDB cardinality status does not report filesystem free space or total memory.
All20 quiz answers reconciled with the corrected guide; availability gap filling, replication and backup assertions no longer imply guarantees.
